title: Demons' Den Sillies
description: Just a silly modpack with focus on ProtoManly's Weather and Create Mods. Made for my followers and server.
body: A modpack for my followers to play on my server. Focus on ProtoManly's weather and Create mods. Other mods include: Handcrafted, Supplementaries and Farmers' Delight for more casual players, and a lot of atmospheric mods like Dynamic trees, Ambient Sounds, to enhance the weather mod.
